name: hk_wind_direction_pollution_rose
requirements: Build a pollution rose for NO2 at Tuen Mun to identify dominant source directions. Please store the results in: highest_no2_direction (str), highest_no2_value (float, 1dp), lowest_no2_direction (str), lowest_no2_value (float, 1dp), north_sector_no2 (float, 1dp).

turns.query: In October 2025, for the Tuen Mun station, compute the average NO2 concentration for each wind direction (using matched weather station data, only when wind speed exceeds 1 m/s to exclude calm conditions). Which wind direction is associated with the highest average NO2 and which with the lowest? Tuen Mun is located in northwestern New Territories — the highest-NO2 wind direction reveals the dominant pollution source region. Return the highest and lowest wind directions with their NO2 values, and the average NO2 when wind is from the north.
